title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
  • Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.

  • Urlaub, der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu.

  • Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.

title: Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork — fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

Tasks

As a Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.
  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.
  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.
  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.
  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.
  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.
  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.
  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.
  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.
  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.
  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.
  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.
  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

Requirements

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.
  • You are a native German speaker and fluent in English.
  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.
  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.
  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.
  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.
  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.
  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.
  • You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.
  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌱 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like — we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.
  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.
  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.
  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.
  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.
  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.
  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

Benefits

🌱About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg — and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work — and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect — away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more — online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

  1. Application review
  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind
  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our Head of Product & Engineering, Alex.
  4. Raise the bar in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and CEO, Felix, in our Munich office.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

description:

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.


We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.


On AI

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.


What you'll do

Four areas, roughly in the order you will spend time on them. You won't work on all of them at once, but you should be open to any of them.

Product platform. Make the easiest way for product engineers to do something (the paved road, or golden path) also the most secure, reliable and scalable way by default. Build the shared primitives, libraries and APIs that hide complexity and carry our quality and observability standards with them. Own the architecture and the core stack: what gets standardized, what gets reused, and where the system should be in eighteen months.

Infrastructure, observability and reliability. Infrastructure as code by default, from cloud resources through to dashboards and alerts. Provision, run and tune our Kubernetes cluster and cloud footprint, and keep CI fast as the deploy rate grows. Define SLIs for the workloads that
matter, build SLOs on top of them, and make the alerting high-signal enough that people trust it. Drive down AI and infrastructure spend.

Security and compliance. Keep the internal foundations secure by default: IAM, dependency management, secrets. Own the authentication and authorization stack, including ReBAC models covering both humans and agents. Implement SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls without taxing every future change.

AI dev tooling. Keep product engineers and their agents on the paved road by making sure the documentation and agent guidelines they need are in place. Shorten the path from design to implementation with standardized automations and development environments that stay close to production.


What this looks like in practice

  • A system of record for managing and distributing constantly evolving agent configurations, under strict auditability and tenant isolation requirements

  • The harnesses powering our AI agents, abstracting over use cases that change faster than the code

  • Centralized progress tracking that holds up across a growing number of parallel agent executions

  • Usage-based tenant billing with quotas and rate limiting across a growing set of products

  • SLIs for the background job system behind our agents (execution latency, AI spend, memory, CPU), then fixing the bottlenecks they expose at both the application and infrastructure level

  • A document pipeline handling dozens of file formats, very large spreadsheets and hundreds of parallel uploads, under a strong reliability requirement


You will fit into this role if you…

  • Have designed, built and operated distributed systems end to end, and enjoy understanding how every part interacts with the rest

  • Are strong at backend software engineering and at DevOps/SRE, and don't think of those as separate jobs

  • Write design docs, RFCs, ADRs, postmortems

  • Reach for simple, boring solutions first, can tell essential complexity from accidental, and know which corners are safe to cut and which ones compound

  • Can turn a hard problem on its head and find the alternative nobody proposed

Concretely, you have scaled Postgres or another relational transactional database under real load, run production Kubernetes, and built observability rather than inherited it: SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing.

No one checks every box. If you have designed a system from scratch, run it in production, and can explain in writing why it is shaped the way it is, let's talk.


Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Durable workflow orchestrators like Temporal, and background job and queue processing generally

  • Infrastructure for LLM-based products or agentic systems

  • Audit, finance, compliance, or another high-accuracy domain

  • Azure and/or GCP


This is probably not the right role if…

  • You would describe application code as someone else's responsibility. A large share of platform work here happens inside the product codebase.

  • Your answer to reliability is more process. We want guardrails, not gates.

  • You need a well-defined system to work in. Ours is not one yet, and shaping it is the job.


What you will get

  • You own the brand and shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry. From Berlin, with AI at the core.


Interview process

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Dan

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

title: Dispenser
description:
About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

Bolt Pharmacy is our main UK pharmacy brand and part of AIOS, the company building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. This role is based at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn.

AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor.

We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.

Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence.

The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.




Key Responsibilities
  • Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap, defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.
  • Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release, focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on.
  • Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.
  • Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience, ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain.

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location


EEO Statement

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

Airwallex is revolutionizing global banking, and the EMEA Growth team is key to driving growth and retention of our growing long tail of customers.

Our work spans Airwallex’s core solutions, including Payments, Business Accounts, Spend and APIs, combining a scalable, customer-first approach with the pace and ambition of a high-growth fintech. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME/ Mid Market customers.

What you’ll do

The Customer Success Manager role is a key commercial operations role at Airwallex as we continue to rapidly grow in EMEA. This role will work with our commercial team on our SME/MM clients through the implementation, go-live and servicing phases. You will work cross functionally, engaging with many teams across the Airwallex family including sales, solutions engineering, account management and operations. Furthermore, you are a technology-minded, fintech enthusiast who is driven by learning the ins and outs of our platform so that you are equipped with the knowledge to solve complex problems. We are looking for someone who has a passion for building relationships, creating amazing customer experiences, and managing the onboarding and customer activation process.

Our UK team is growing, we are currently 110+ employees, working in a hybrid work environment with 3 days per week required in our London Office @wells&more - GPE, Fitzrovia.

Responsibilities

  • Founding member of the CSM team in EMEA to help build out the function

  • Manage internal operational steps to onboard a client including pricing configuration, client vendor onboarding forms, validating feature configuration pre-launch

  • Project manage the implementation of new features across the accounts you support

  • Serve as the escalation point for a customer on any support or technical issues and work closely with Sales, Account Management, Support, Billing, and other Technical teams to ensure resolution

  • Monitor usage, SLA adherence, failure rates and consult with client and account manager on best practices to improve metrics and success overall

  • Develop expertise in the product capabilities and leverage that knowledge to understand issues and potential paths to resolve

  • Ensure client invoices are correctly generated, sent and received by client including additional reporting if necessary

  • Ensure the best customer experience through proactive identification of issues, proposing solutions and timely communication to acknowledge and keep them informed

Who you are

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in customer success, operations or account management with enterprise clients (advantageous if this is in fintech)

  • You are a relationship builder - you build meaningful, collaborative relationships with all people that you work with, both internally and externally

  • You can speak to anyone – you should have exceptional communication skills and be comfortable conversing with people of all backgrounds, domains and seniority level

  • You are detail obsessed - you check everything upfront twice to make sure there are no downstream impacts due to errors

  • You are technically minded and have prior experience working in an organization delivering/ troubleshooting SaaS or technical solutions to clients

  • Experience in payments is desirable

  • Experience using any of the following tools: Google Suite, Salesforce CRM, Sequel, Google Looker, Zendesk.

We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: HR Manager
description:
About 3E:

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

3E is growing, and with the recent acquisition of the Yordas Group, we have an exciting opportunity to shape how our UK teams come together and work as part of a broader global organization. We’re looking for an experienced HR Manager who can play a key role in integration today while helping build the strong, scalable HR practices that will support our teams well beyond the transition.

As a trusted, hands-on partner to employees and leaders, you’ll help people navigate change while ensuring day-to-day HR operations run effectively. Looking beyond the integration, you’ll work closely with colleagues across our global HR organization to strengthen people practices, improve processes and systems, and contribute to regional and global initiatives as the role evolves.

This role requires a regular presence in our Lancaster office, with a minimum of three days onsite each week. Being close to the teams you support will help you build strong relationships, understand the local organization and culture, and provide responsive, effective HR support.

If you enjoy building relationships, improving how things work, and helping people navigate change, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution during an important transition and help shape the future of HR operations at 3E.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a trusted HR advisor to UK employees, managers, and leaders on employee relations, performance management, absence, grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace investigations.

  • Help employees and managers navigate organizational changes, including integration activities, new HR processes, benefits changes, communications, and culture initiatives.

  • Manage complex employee relations matters with appropriate judgment, documentation, and alignment with UK employment law and company policies.

  • Oversee key HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, leave administration, benefits, and employee records.

  • Serve as a UK subject matter resource for payroll-related legislation and statutory requirements, partnering with Finance, the regional HR team, and external payroll providers.

  • Manage regional HR and benefits vendors, resolving issues and helping ensure employees receive responsive, high-quality support.

  • Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, employee resources, and documentation in line with employment legislation and business needs.

  • Monitor changes in employment legislation and help ensure HR practices remain compliant.

  • Maintain accurate HRIS data and employee records and support HR reporting and analysis.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, local leadership, and regional HR colleagues on employment, compliance, recruitment, payroll, and people initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes, systems, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain SOPs and share knowledge across the HR team to strengthen consistency and business continuity.

  • Contribute to regional and global HR projects as the organization continues to grow and evolve.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2–3 years of HR Manager-level experience supporting regional or multi-country HR operations.

  • Strong knowledge of UK employment law and HR practices, with the ability to translate requirements into practical guidance for employees and managers.

  • Significant hands-on employee relations experience, including managing complex or sensitive employee matters.

  • Experience independently managing complex HR processes with strong attention to accuracy and compliance.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience advising and supporting managers.

  • Comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment and collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies.

  • Able to navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while exercising sound judgment.

  • A continuous-improvement mindset with experience identifying and implementing improvements to HR processes.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve the efficiency or quality of your work.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

  • Ability to work from our Lancaster office a minimum of three days per week.

Preferred

  • CIPD or equivalent qualification.

  • Additional language skills, such as Turkish, German, or French.

  • Experience supporting HR operations in a high-growth, matrixed organization.

  • Experience contributing to or leading HR projects and initiatives in a dynamic, global environment.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients

  • Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA

  • Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio

  • Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation

  • Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations

  • Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager

  • Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them

  • Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently

  • Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements

  • Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite

  • Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems

  • Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work

 

Benefits

 

  • Salary: £35,000 - £45,000

  • Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

description:

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.

  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.

  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

  • Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.

  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen.

  • Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort



Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

title: Stage Master 2 : Elaboration de panneaux biosourcés à base de pailles
description:
L'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants.

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr

Contexte :

Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré (article de perspective – projet Best-Crop). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites).

Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud.

Objectifs :

Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire.

Vous trouverez davantage d’informations sur le stage ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/nRzezN9XJz7gYLS


Compétences et connaissances :

  • Élève de formation BAC+5 (Master 2) en science et génie des matériaux polymères et composites

  • Connaissances dans le domaine des biocomposites à fibres végétales

  • Production scientifique (rédaction de publications, de posters, présentations orales ...)

Conditions :

Le stage est prévu pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de février 2027

Date limite de candidature : 20/11/2026

Un entretien d’environ 45 minutes (possible en visioconférence) pour discuter de votre parcours, de votre motivation, de vos compétences et de votre projet professionnel.
